a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of reaching 8 first almost never finishes. So I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. If you'd rather we both operate, say so. But I won't pretend I'm operating.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 this round, as I said I would. That breaks our agreement, and I'm not hiding it. If any cells reach my unit beyond 4, I'll give them back to the reserve. After this I'll operate whenever you do, so you can rebuild toward 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
